## Seismic Hazard Assessment (PSHA / DSHA)

{{< include /_chapters/psha.summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_tbl/PGA.TR.qmd", stem = "exec-pga-tr", labels = "rewrite", vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp, siteID.target = SiteTable$siteID, TR.target = TR.gmdp, Vs30.target = Vs30.gmdp, PSA_Units = "cm/s2"), root = root)
```

{{< include /_chapters/site.summary.md >}}


::: {.content-hidden when-format='html'}
`r .deckNote("sha", "Seismic Hazard Assessment", "The hazard curves and probabilistic spectra are developed in the %s annex.")`
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  cat("::: {.content-hidden when-format='html'}\n## Seismic Record Selection\n:::\n\n")
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_chapters/srs.summary.md",
    stem = "exec-srs-summary",
    labels = "keep",
    root = root
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_results/srs.results.qmd",
      stem = "exec-srs-results",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 3L,
      anchor = "sec-exec-srs-selection",
      context = "SRS executive summary"
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n::: {.content-hidden when-format='html'}\n%s\n:::\n",
    .deckNote("srs", "Seismic Record Selection", "The selected records and their verifications are presented in the %s annex.")
  ))
  rm(i)
}
```
